description_en: Updates the role-based access control (RBAC) permissions of a RAM user
kebab_example: aliyun adcp update-user-permission --role-type cluster --role-name admin --cluster-id c8e28143817db4b039b8548d7c8990000 --user-id 21760000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateUserPermission

parameters.help_en:
The authorization type. Valid values:

cluster: specifies that the permissions are scoped to a master instance.
namespace: specifies that the permissions are scoped to a namespace of a cluster
parameters.help_zh:
授权类型，取值：

cluster：主控实例维度。
namespace: 命名空间维度
parameters.name: role_type

parameters.help_en:
The predefined role. Valid values:

admin: administrator
dev: developer
parameters.help_zh:
预置的角色名称，取值：

admin: 管理员。
dev：开发人员
parameters.name: role_name

parameters.help_en: The ID of the master instance
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The namespace to which the permissions are scoped. By default, this parameter is empty when you set RoleType to cluster
parameters.help_zh: 命名空间名称，主控实例维度授权时默认为空
parameters.name: namespace

parameters.help_en: The ID of the RAM user
parameters.name: user_id
